content: Type 5 Diabetes, as defined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), Stage 2 is identified by specific abnormalities in glucose metabolism.6 to 6.9 mmol/L). Additionally, when a 2-hour plasma glucose test is performed, the levels fall within the range of 140 to 199 mg/dL (equivalent to 7.8 to 11.0 mmol/L). Furthermore, the glycated hemoglobin (A1C) level in this stage is observed to be between 5.7% and 6.4%. These parameters indicate an intermediate degree of impaired glucose tolerance, which is a critical marker for this stage.
